message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: a Party branch secretary (village party secretary) received bribes from a real estate developer's representative. He received money via his father’s bank account, directly, etc. So it's bribery. Since he is a public official (village party secretary) - a state functionary. The label list includes "受贿" (bribery) and "非国家工作人员受贿" (bribery by non-state staff). He is a Party official, which is a state functionary. So "受贿". Also possibly "滥用职权"? He used his position to accept bribes, but the crime is bribery. The list includes "滥用职权" (abuse of power). However the facts only mention receiving bribes, not abusing power. So just "受贿". The example earlier: "非国家工作人员受贿" used when the person is not a state employee. Here he is a Party secretary, which is a state employee. So "受贿". Return format: [罪名]受贿<eoa>.
